source_caption:
🎥🎬: Fightland

Fightland steps inside a boxing world where every fighter is chasing the same dream: a chance to become a champion. But talent alone isn’t enough. Money, influence, promoters, and rivalries shape careers, forcing fighters to navigate a business where trusting the wrong person can cost them everything.

With pressure mounting inside and outside the ring, friendships are tested and ambitions begin to clash. Every fight becomes another step toward greatness, but the closer they get to the top, the more they discover just how much they may have to sacrifice to stay there.

Fightland — the new series everyone’s talking about, only on @STARZ.

source_details.title: Fightland
source_details.synopsis: Fightland is a boxing crime drama television series created by Daniel Fajemisin-Duncan, Marlon Smith, Damione Macedon and Raphael Jackson Jr.. It premiered on July 31, 2026, on Starz in the United States and August 27, 2026, on Sky Atlantic in the United Kingdom.
